Answer three questions only.

1 Imaginative Composition (Compulsory) (20 marks)
Choose any one of the following pwo questions,
Either
(a) Write a story beginning:
From his physical appearance, it was not possible to tell that the speaker had a great
deal of wisdom...
Or
(b) Write a composition explaining the importance of the group discussions when dealing
with complex issues.
2 The Compulsory Set Text (20 marks)

Paul B. Vitta: Fathers of Nations
Professor Kimani’s challenges are evidence of the impact of failed leadership on citizens.
Using examples from the text, Fathers of Nations, write an essay in support of this statement.

3 The Optional Set Texts (20 marks)
Answer any one of the following three questions.

Either
(a) The Short Story
Godwin Siundu (Ed.): A Silent Song and Other Stories

Life in the city is not always as good as we may imagine. Using relevant
illustrations from Meja Mwangi’s short story “/ncident in the Park”, write an essay

in support of this view,
(b) Drama
Adipo Sidang’: Parliament of Owls

Misuse of power is the cause of many evils in our society. With reference to
Money Bags in Adipo Sidang’s Parliament of Owls, write an essay in support of this
statement.

(c) The Novel
Kazuo Ishiguro: An Artist of the Floating World

The good that we do will not go unnoticed. Write an essay in support of this
statement with illustrations from Kazuo Ishiguro’s An Artist of the Floating World.
